name: io.github.godwin105/arbiter
description: Is this transaction safe to sign? Decodes what it really does and answers allow, warn or block.

environmentVariables.name: ARBITER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Arbiter deployment to call. Defaults to the hosted service.

environmentVariables.name: ARBITER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded 64-byte Algorand private key used to pay for calls. The account needs USDC and must be opted in to the USDC asset. Without it every request stops at the paywall.

environmentVariables.name: ARBITER_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spending cap for this process, in USD. Enforced before anything is signed.

environmentVariables.name: ARBITER_MAX_PRICE_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call priced above this, in USD.
